review_text: This cafe has a nice atmosphere for getting work done - lots of tables and outlets, free WiFi, and fairly quiet background music compared to other busy coffee shops.
Love being in here and experience the warmth of coffee and peace. Love the food and the place itself. RECOMMENDED AND MUST TRY!!! 💗

True to its name, Coffee and Peace offers a wide selection of coffee. Every cup, from the traditional espresso to specialised pour-overs, is a monument to the skill and commitment of the baristas to excellence.
I love the ambiance of the cafe! Their foods are really tasty and priced reasonably. I'm definitely going back.
I love the ambiance of the entire shop, plus the products are absolutely incredible even for the budget meal only!
A perfect spot to relax, work, and catch up with friends. Highly recommend!
